text:
The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is accelerating the integration of advanced air mobility (AAM) and next-generation aircraft into the National Airspace System, which will expand commercial use cases for eVTOL and hybrid-electric flight. The agency [unveiled eight selections](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/future-aviation-here-trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-and-faa-unveil-eight) for a pilot program to test these aircraft across cargo, personal travel, and emergency medicine. In a related milestone, BETA Technologies and United Therapeutics [completed a flight test](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/faa-announces-major-milestone-evtol-technology-use) of eVTOL organ medical transport from Virginia to Maryland. Additionally, the Department of Transportation and FAA [broke ground on a new research facility](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/dot-and-faa-break-ground-new-facility-support-advanced-air-mobility-research) in Oklahoma City to support AAM testing and training.

The FAA is also prioritizing the modernization of air traffic control (ATC) and workforce expansion. The agency [hired 2,235 air traffic controller trainees](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/faa-breaks-all-time-record-air-traffic-controller-trainee-hiring), an all-time record, and partnered with Shenandoah University and Angelo State University to [expand the candidate pipeline](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-sean-p-duffy-announces-first-texas-college-join-air) via the Enhanced Air Traffic-Collegiate Training Initiative. To support these personnel, the FAA [opened a new control tower](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/faa-opens-new-asheville-air-traffic-control-tower-support-record-growth-western-north) in Asheville, North Carolina, and a [manufacturing plant in Maryland](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/trumps-transportation-secretary-duffy-faa-administrator-bedford-celebrate-opening-key) to produce digital Voice-over-IP voice switches.

Industry developments show a trend toward enhancing uncrewed system security and autonomy. The FAA [awarded $12 million](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/faa-funds-drone-research-support-safe-integration) to 19 companies for drone research and [signed a safety agreement](https://www.faa.gov/newsroom/faa-and-dow-sign-landmark-safety-agreement-protect-southern-border) with the Department of War regarding a high-energy laser counter-drone system. In the autonomous vehicle sector, the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration [permitted driverless trucks](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNQlVRTk1zNHRWQnNXcm1RV2Y2Q1VIR212OXJxaUVVb1oxQWxpUjY1WVhiMHhMZzVrSml2TGdVQVN5a3czLUpmNDZZUEY4cEkxTUFmMktBSUppQUNxNkpRcUYwa1VEdmF3NzROR0J2dmdXdGM4QS0ySjg1dTZONFdqOEtIc2NndGU2cjNtWTVlNDlTX3VoZXkwelRYdU43dlk2WGFpRy13NU0wSXA5LUctZDM5ZTlDRjFr) to replace traditional hazard triangles with cab-mounted beacons.
